full_page.content:
ST. FELIX FRIARY HUNTINGTON, IND. May 12th 1946
Miss Doris Panyard Muskegon, Michigan
God bless you and yours, Miss Panyard.
I am glad to know that your Mother feels well enough and is looking forward to making the little trip down to our Monastery here just up over the hill from Huntington. I think an experienced driver ought to be able to make the trip easily enough in five or six hours. It is only about 125 miles from Chicago, and it ought not be difficult to cut off fifty of that by a straighter route, e.g. via South Bend, Elkart or Coldwater. This last might be out of your way but in case there is a direct highway from the North I could guide you pretty well from that point. The Fathers of Detroit and Huntington usually go that way when driving. Its just 100 miles out of Detroit. That would be to far Eastward for you.
Well we'll just pray the dear Lord to be your Guide - Maybe as He was to the young Tobias, through St. Raphael.
Yours Sincerely in Christ
Fr. Solanus
P.S. Coldwater is 70 miles from Fort Wayne - I think its 17 (Hi-way) out of Coldwater - there from FrWay 30 miles S.West #24.
Short Message handwritten on enclosed Holy Card:
. God bless you Grace Panyard.
Foster Confidence in God - courage reenforced by the divine. . . . "whom the Lord loveth He chasteneth."
Fr. Solanus ....
